messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

Use formal R&S CMX500 specifications and features documents for our signaling tester claims, because the CMX500 page ties formal specs to Version 11.00, August 2025, and features/functions to Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher [75].
Use formal option evidence for signaling scope, such as CMX500 NR, LTE, WLAN, RedCap, NTN and NB-NTN signaling option codes listed in the CMX500 features passages [76][77].
Do not use the UAV “Signaling test solution” note as final configuration evidence, because it lacks formal release date, author, version, configuration guide, license bundle, quotation tool version and release date [22].
Use formal non-signaling feature evidence before claiming non-signaling capability, because the CMX500 GPRF Generator passage is a presentation-derived non-signaling use case, not a formal feature list or specification [25][26].
Verify release status with release notes before using roadmap claims, because the GPRF Generator page says “Planned for CSW 9.00 / coming with CSW 9.10” must be verified by release note [26].
Use competitor official datasheets, option lists, versions, order numbers and test conditions before making competitor capability claims, because the Keysight battle card does not provide official Keysight datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status or test conditions [16].
Amarisoft sources are sales positioning rather than formal specifications [15][30].
Validate claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” “fully integrated” or similar competitive language with formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports or configuration tools [13][83].
For an Amarisoft comparison, obtain Amarisoft official or third-party evidence, because current Amarisoft limitations in the knowledge base come only from an R&S sales battle card and are not Amarisoft official specifications or third-party market validation [32][33].
For an Anritsu Virtual Signalling Tester comparison, use Anritsu evidence for protocol stack, interfaces and required hardware, because the knowledge base states it is a PC-based software protocol simulator for NR / RedCap and that RF-IF still uses Anritsu MD8190A and MX819020A [7][8][70].
For an Anritsu comparison, obtain full test case lists, scenario library, 3GPP release coverage, conformance status, throughput metrics and timing / synchronization requirements, because the current Virtual Signalling Tester page explicitly lacks those details [73].
For AI-assisted scripting claims, use product-version, license, deployment, supported CMX software release, XLAPI version, benchmark, correctness metric, coverage matrix and validation-method evidence, because the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant passages lack these items [50][89][90].
For AI workflow value claims, provide quantified benchmark and validation methodology, because the AI-assisted workflow passages list metrics such as time to first test, mean time to debug, regression coverage and reuse of tests but state that no quantitative benchmark or validation method is provided [35].
For generative-AI application testing claims, provide test setup and KPI evidence aligned to the CMX500 generative AI UX testbed, because the supported CMX500 AI application testing passage measures end-user experience under configurable network conditions using KPIs such as Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second [52][54].
For security, deployment or data-governance AI claims, obtain deployment options, model details, retrieval / training boundary, data residency, security controls, update mechanism and customer-data handling evidence, because the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant source does not provide those details [50][91].
For “Virtual tester” claims, do not equate R&S AI Workplace “Virtual tester” with Anritsu “Virtual Signalling Tester,” because the knowledge base says there is no source supporting that they are the same product, architecture or market category [9].
For any formal customer-facing comparison, distinguish binding specifications from non-binding feature language, because the CMX500 specifications page defines binding specification conditions and says features/functions data without tolerance limits is not binding [75].

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping
[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 提供 2026.3.4 R&S high-speed digital 簡報中的 PCB fabricator / system house 測試流程；本頁則來自市場 Excel，將 R&S 儀器與 AI server supply-chain 類別做銷售 mapping。
- [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] 與 [[Dk-Df]]、[[Delta-L]]、[[TDR 阻抗測量]] 已有 Keysight / PCB test 圖像來源；本頁新增 R&S 方案對應，但未提供可替代正式規格的量測條件。
- [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 記錄材料與板層升級；本頁只補充對應測試入口，例如 IL、TDR、high speed trace、PDN Target Z。
- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]]、[[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 與 [[AI 資料中心高壓直流供電]] 記錄 data center power electronics；本頁補充 [[MXO]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[ZISO]] 與 BMS test 的 sales mapping 線索。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › Jitter / phase noise / clock / LDO noise
- [[R&S FSWP]] 在 [[伺服器主機板]]分類中被列為 LDO NSD test、clock jitter test。
- [[R&S FSWP]] 在 [[網通交換機]]分類中被列為 jitter / phase noise test。
- [[R&S FSWP]] 也出現在 [[電源供應器]]的 LDO NSD test、[[智原]]與[[譜瑞-KY]]的 IC / high-speed transmission solution 欄，但未提供測試條件。

AISeverEcosystem › 與既有知識的關係
- [[AI Server 供應鏈總覽]] 已整理 AI server 從 demand、compute、ODM、networking、PCB/interconnect、power、cooling 到 infrastructure 的八段式供應鏈；本來源新增更偏台股 / customer targeting / R&S solution mapping 的 Excel 表格視角。
- [[AI 資料中心生態系]] 已整理多張 AI data center ecosystem / industrial chain 圖；本來源提供更細的 server rack 零組件與 IC 分類，但來源未標示日期，不能直接更新為市場現況。
- [[臺灣 AI 伺服器供應鏈]] 依 TAITRA 2024/4 圖整理上中下游；本來源與其在 [[台光電]]、[[台燿]]、[[聯茂]]、[[欣興]]、[[南電]]、[[景碩]]、[[鴻海]]、[[廣達]]、[[緯創]]、[[英業達]]、[[台達電]]、[[光寶科]]、[[康舒]]、[[建準]]、[[川湖]]、[[勤誠]]等列名上高度相鄰，但本來源另加入 R&S solution 欄。
- [[AI 伺服器 ODM]] 已整理台系 ODM 比較表與組裝代工列名；本來源在 [[伺服器整合／ODM]] 欄再次列出 [[鴻海]]、[[廣達]]、[[緯創]]、[[緯穎]]、[[英業達]]、[[華碩]]、[[神達]]、[[技嘉]]，但沒有營收、出貨或期間資料。
- [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 已記錄 GB200 / GB300 / VR200 與 PCB 材料升級；本來源只以 `GB200/NVL72帶動層數、材料等級暴衝` 和 `20+層UBB、高階ABF、低Dk CCL` 補充銷售 / solution mapping 脈絡，沒有新增可量化規格。
- [[AI 伺服器液冷散熱]] 已整理液冷 / Microchannel lid 與 VR200 散熱估算；本來源新增 [[GPU]] TDP 700 W → 1200 W 與液冷 / 滑軌升級的表格說法，但未標示平台、年份或測試條件。
- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]] 與 [[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 已整理 HVDC、PSU、BBU、PDU 等 power electronics 脈絡；本來源補充電源供應器分類中的 HVDC、5–10 kW PSU、液冷電源櫃、BBU 與 Blackwell 平台功耗翻倍說法，但未提供引用文件或期間。
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 已整理 R&S 2026.3.4 high-speed digital 簡報中的 material measurement、stackup selection、SI testing 與 sampling / process monitoring；本來源把部分 R&S solution 對應到特定市場分類，例如 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] 的 IL / TDR、[[R&S FSWP]] 的 jitter / phase noise / LDO NSD test、[[MXO]] 的 power rail / motor driver analysis。

- 來源把 [[R&S CMW500]] 用於 2G/3G continuity；既有 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 已列 GSM、WCDMA、LTE、NR Sub-6GHz、Bluetooth、WLAN 等 CMW wireless standards，方向一致。
- 來源把 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 作為 production / non-signaling / ATE path；既有各產品頁也把 CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 K06 描述為 production / manufacturing / nonsignaling 測試相關平台，方向一致。
- 來源對 [[amarisoft]] 的資訊是 sales battle card 觀點，且未引用 amarisoft 官方文件；應避免把 “Only R&S” 等銷售語句當作獨立技術規格或市場事實。

amarisoft
[[amarisoft]] 是一間來源描述為法國小型私人公司的 software-based [[4G]] / [[5G]] network stacks and test systems 供應商；目前本頁僅依 R&S internal battle card 記錄其在 [[R&S CMX500]] 競品比較中的定位。

amarisoft › 來源中的競品定位
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 將 [[amarisoft]] 定位為 cost-efficient and flexible for functional testing，但列出以下限制：

- 缺少 calibrated RF。
- 缺少 conformance / operator acceptance assurance。
- 缺少 validated NTN。
- 缺少 global support、calibration labs、field service、SLAs。
- 缺少 instrument-class long warranty。
- FR2 依賴 external hardware / external RRH，來源以 “calibration?” 標示疑問。
- 缺少 2G/3G stack。
- 缺少 Wi-Fi signaling。
- 缺少 production / ATE testers 與 non-signaling factory-line path。

以上是 R&S sales battle card 的競品論述；不是 [[amarisoft]] 官方規格，也不是第三方市場驗證。

amarisoft › unresolved
- 來源沒有引用 [[amarisoft]] 官方文件；所有資訊目前都來自 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]。
- 公司規模在同一來源中出現 **15–50** 與 **15–25** 兩種寫法。
- “up to 1000 UEs”、NB-IoT、LTE-M、RedCap、basic NTN 等能力缺少型號、軟體版本、SDR hardware 與測試條件。
- “no global footprint”、“remote-only support”、“no Wi-Fi signaling”、“no production/ATE testers” 等競品限制需另以 amarisoft 官方資料或第三方來源確認。

AI-assisted agentic test workflows
[[AI-assisted agentic test workflows]] 是 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 用來描述 AI 協助測試建立、結果分析與工具整合的一組客戶需求場景，重點在 agentic workflow 如何連到既有 engineering environment；[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]] 另提供一個 [[R&S CMX500]] scripting / automation solution-level 例子。

AI-assisted agentic test workflows › 成功指標
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 列出可衡量 AI-assisted test workflow 價值的 metrics：

- time to first test；
- mean time to debug；
- regression coverage；
- reuse of tests；
- fewer expert escalations；
- faster scripting；
- fewer debug cycles；
- better reuse of tests；
- less expert dependency。

[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]] 的 PR 語言與這些 metrics 有方向性對應，例如 significantly less time and effort、reducing the risk of errors 與 speeding up time-to-market；但來源未提供量化 benchmark 或驗證方法。

AI-assisted agentic test workflows › 限制與未決事項
- [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 是 questionnaire，不是功能規格書。
- [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]] 是新聞稿，不是 specifications、deployment guide 或 security architecture。
- 兩份來源都未提供完整 AI agent 架構、模型版本、API、支援儀器清單或部署拓樸。
- [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 未說明 [[AI-assisted agentic test workflows]] 是否為正式產品名稱。
- [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 未將此概念直接對應到 [[ScriptAssist]] 或 [[TechAssist]] 任一產品；[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 來源也未提到 [[R&S AI Workplace]]，不可自行推論。
- [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 的 deployment options、license、版本、資料治理與適用 [[R&S CMX500]] software release 仍未標示。

Virtual tester › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 與 point tools 的區分
問卷第 3b 題要求客戶說明他們是在尋找 point tools，或 broader [[Virtual tester]]：

- point tools examples：better scripting、log analysis。
- broader [[Virtual tester]]：spans implementation → test → debug → validation。

這個區分表示 [[Virtual tester]] 的範圍比單一 scripting assistant 或 log analyzer 更寬，但來源未提供具體產品功能矩陣。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：

- test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程理解；
- test script generation 或 refactoring；
- ambiguous logs / failure debugging；
- documentation lookup；
- end-to-end test execution；
- toolchain integration：repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines；
- [[Orchestration layer]] 對 AI agents 的 rules、instructions、skills coordination。

以上是問卷問題範圍，不是已確認產品功能。

R&S AI Workplace
[[R&S AI Workplace]] 是 [[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_ScriptAssist]] 與 [[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_TechAssist]] 中作為所有 AIW Assists 共同基礎需求的 AI workplace 產品 / 方案名稱；[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 另從 customer discovery 角度補充其與 virtual testing、AI-assisted / agentic test workflows 與工具整合需求的關係。

R&S AI Workplace › 已知 AIW Assists
目前本庫由 prerequisites 文件確認下列 AIW Assists：

- [[ScriptAssist]]：[[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_ScriptAssist]] 記錄其 RAM >= 24GB、No GPUs Required，以及 customer LLMs and Embedding Models are used。
- [[TechAssist]]：[[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_TechAssist]] 記錄其 Workstation / Mac 硬體條件、local [[Embedding Model]] next to [[MCP Server]] 的 GPU 相關腳註，以及必要時的 [[CMX Access]]。

[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 沒有新增正式 AIW Assist 名稱；它提到 [[Customer agent harness]] concept，但未說明其是否為產品、功能或方案元件。

R&S AI Workplace › Customer discovery questionnaire 視角
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 補充 [[R&S AI Workplace]] 相關討論會先收集以下資訊：

- Current workflow and pain：從 new test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程，以及 scripting、environment setup、debugging failures、documentation 等耗時點。
- AI and tooling readiness：是否已使用 AI coding assistants、IDE agents、CI bots 或 internal automation；並收集 data residency、air-gapped labs、cloud / LLM use approval 等政策限制。
- Integration and ecosystem：客戶的 instruments、software、CI、issue trackers，以及 [[Orchestration layer]] 要 plug in 的位置。
- Point tools vs [[Virtual tester]]：客戶是需要 better scripting / log analysis 等 point tools，或需要跨 implementation → test → debug → validation 的 broader [[Virtual tester]]。
- Outcomes：time to first test、mean time to debug、regression coverage、reuse of tests、fewer expert escalations。
- Risk and adoption：technical、organizational、compliance blockers，以及需要 vendor 提供 training、reference architectures、security documentation 或 pilot support。
- Tools & AI harness：[[Claude Code]]、[[Cursor]] 或 similar tools、license / approval flow、guardrails、integration with repos / CI/CD / test frameworks / lab equipment interfaces / log pipelines，以及 [[Customer agent harness]] 優先 orchestration 的任務。

Coding Agent Harness › Customer questionnaire 中的 Tools & AI harness
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 第 6 段標題為 `Tools & AI harness (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, similar)`，它不是部署 prerequisites，而是詢問客戶：

- 目前使用哪些 AI-assisted development tools，例如 coding agents in the IDE、CLI agents、chat assistants。
- 產品名稱與 typical use cases：coding、review、test generation、docs。
- 授權狀態：individual licenses、team / enterprise、evaluation only。
- 新工具核准者：IT、security、engineering leadership。
- 是否多工具並用或有 standard environment；若多工具並用，如何避免 fragmented workflows。
- tools 如何 connect to repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines。
- guardrails：allowed models、data handling、on-prem vs cloud、`no code leaves the lab`。
- test automation 是否已使用 AI generate 或 refactor test scripts，或 only for application code。
- 若採用 [[Customer agent harness]] concept，期待它先 orchestration scripting、documentation lookup、log analysis 或 end-to-end test execution。
- 90 天 success：faster scripting、fewer debug cycles、better reuse of tests、less expert dependency，以及 must-have vs nice-to-have tool integration。

Coding Agent Harness
[[Coding Agent Harness]] 在 [[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_ScriptAssist]] 與 [[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_TechAssist]] 中指 [[R&S AI Workplace]] on-prem deployment 需要選定的 coding agent 執行環境或工具介面；[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 另以 Tools & AI harness 問卷形式調查客戶現有 AI-assisted development tools 與可能的 [[Customer agent harness]] 期待。

Coding Agent Harness › 與 AI Workplace prerequisites 的關係
[[Coding Agent Harness]] 屬於 Base [[R&S AI Workplace]] requirements，因此是所有 AIW Assists always needed 的一部分。[[ScriptAssist]] 與 [[TechAssist]] 都需要先滿足這些 base requirements，再滿足各自的 product-specific requirements。

[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 則用問卷蒐集客戶現有 harness / toolchain 與 governance 情況，補充 prerequisites 文件沒有涵蓋的 adoption / integration 問題。

Customer agent harness
[[Customer agent harness]] 是 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 第 6g 題使用的概念，用來詢問若客戶採用一個 agent harness，最期待它先 orchestration 哪些測試自動化任務。

Customer agent harness › 來源語境
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 第 6 段標題為 `Tools & AI harness (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, similar)`，問題涵蓋客戶現有 AI-assisted development tools、授權、核准流程、guardrails、工程資產連接方式與 test automation 使用情況。

第 6g 題明確詢問：

> If you adopted a “customer agent harness” concept, what would you expect it to orchestrate first: scripting, documentation lookup, log analysis, or end-to-end test execution?

Customer agent harness › 可能優先 orchestration 的任務
來源列出的候選任務是：

- scripting；
- documentation lookup；
- log analysis；
- end-to-end test execution。

這些是問卷選項，不代表產品已支援。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]]：本來源介紹的 AI-powered scripting assistant。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：本工具搭配的 5G one-box signaling tester / radio communication tester。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：本來源發布者與工具提供者。
- [[XLAPI]]：來源明示工具可生成 accurate XLAPI scripts，並可處理既有 XLAPI scripts。
- [[Python]]：來源列為測試工程師手動生成 scripts 時可能彙整的輸入之一。
- [[3GPP specifications]]：來源列為 script generation 的輸入來源之一。
- [[AI-assisted agentic test workflows]]：本來源提供一個具體的 AI-assisted scripting / test automation solution-level 例子。
- [[R&S AI Workplace]]、[[ScriptAssist]]：名稱與用途可能相關，但本來源未提到 AI Workplace 或 ScriptAssist；不得自行合併。

- [[ScriptAssist]] 被描述為 AI-powered script generation tool，可加速 NTN-specific R&D protocol and application testing 以及 instrument automation 的 scripting。

Use formal R&S CMX500 specifications and features documents for our signaling tester claims, because the CMX500 page ties formal specs to Version 11.00, August 2025, and features/functions to Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher [75].
Use formal option evidence for signaling scope, such as CMX500 NR, LTE, WLAN, RedCap, NTN and NB-NTN signaling option codes listed in the CMX500 features passages [76][77].
Do not use the UAV “Signaling test solution” note as final configuration evidence, because it lacks formal release date, author, version, configuration guide, license bundle, quotation tool version and release date [22].
Use formal non-signaling feature evidence before claiming non-signaling capability, because the CMX500 GPRF Generator passage is a presentation-derived non-signaling use case, not a formal feature list or specification [25][26].
Verify release status with release notes before using roadmap claims, because the GPRF Generator page says “Planned for CSW 9.00 / coming with CSW 9.10” must be verified by release note [26].
Use competitor official datasheets, option lists, versions, order numbers and test conditions before making competitor capability claims, because the Keysight battle card does not provide official Keysight datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status or test conditions [16].
Amarisoft sources are sales positioning rather than formal specifications [15][30].
Validate claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” “fully integrated” or similar competitive language with formal datasheets, features documents, conformance reports or configuration tools [13][83].
For an Amarisoft comparison, obtain Amarisoft official or third-party evidence, because current Amarisoft limitations in the knowledge base come only from an R&S sales battle card and are not Amarisoft official specifications or third-party market validation [32][33].
For an Anritsu Virtual Signalling Tester comparison, use Anritsu evidence for protocol stack, interfaces and required hardware, because the knowledge base states it is a PC-based software protocol simulator for NR / RedCap and that RF-IF still uses Anritsu MD8190A and MX819020A [7][8][70].
For an Anritsu comparison, obtain full test case lists, scenario library, 3GPP release coverage, conformance status, throughput metrics and timing / synchronization requirements, because the current Virtual Signalling Tester page explicitly lacks those details [73].
For AI-assisted scripting claims, use product-version, license, deployment, supported CMX software release, XLAPI version, benchmark, correctness metric, coverage matrix and validation-method evidence, because the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant passages lack these items [50][89][90].
For AI workflow value claims, provide quantified benchmark and validation methodology, because the AI-assisted workflow passages list metrics such as time to first test, mean time to debug, regression coverage and reuse of tests but state that no quantitative benchmark or validation method is provided [35].
For generative-AI application testing claims, provide test setup and KPI evidence aligned to the CMX500 generative AI UX testbed, because the supported CMX500 AI application testing passage measures end-user experience under configurable network conditions using KPIs such as Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second [52][54].
For security, deployment or data-governance AI claims, obtain deployment options, model details, retrieval / training boundary, data residency, security controls, update mechanism and customer-data handling evidence, because the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant source does not provide those details [50][91].
For “Virtual tester” claims, do not equate R&S AI Workplace “Virtual tester” with Anritsu “Virtual Signalling Tester,” because the knowledge base says there is no source supporting that they are the same product, architecture or market category [9].
For any formal customer-facing comparison, distinguish binding specifications from non-binding feature language, because the CMX500 specifications page defines binding specification conditions and says features/functions data without tolerance limits is not binding [75].
